subject: Require seek-sector arrival before launching point post-seek work
description: A point seek could terminate through its authored Stop transition while still outside the stored seek sector, yet Rust launched the retained post-seek sequence as though the destination had been reached. Original launches point-target post-seek work only when mpSeekSector still equals the actor's current sector after that transition. Point-seek completion now preserves stale attached work rather than executing it when the sector check fails. The focused stopped-short regression passes and the representative matches exact EOF.
